Class Individual

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.domain.Individual
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AgentView
Direct Known Subclasses:
Symbiont
public class Individual extends Object implements Serializable, AgentView
Canonical Domain Entity representing an individual eusocial insect in the simulation. Implements AgentView for direct bridge and inter-compatibility with the ECS and Rendering engines.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant

    • calculateChcDissimilarity

      public float calculateChcDissimilarity(Individual other)
      Calculates Bray-Curtis CHC dissimilarity index d_BC between this individual and another: d_BC(u, v) = sum(|u_k - v_k|) / sum(u_k + v_k) Returns a distance in [0.0, 1.0].

    • performBarbedBeeSting

      public boolean performBarbedBeeSting(Individual targetEnemy)
      Honeybee worker barbed sting defense against other arthropods/insects. Inflicts severe apitoxin venom damage (40.0) and releases alarm pheromone (isopentyl acetate). Biological Realism: When stinging rigid chitinous insect cuticle, the barbs do NOT systematically tear the abdomen (autotomy rate ~12% if wedged in hard sclerite). The worker bee survives in ~88% of cases and can continue active nest defense.

    • performMammalianDefensiveSting

      public boolean performMammalianDefensiveSting(float envenomationDamage)
      Honeybee worker barbed sting defense against vertebrate/mammalian predators (Bears, Mice, Humans). The thick, elastic dermis traps the recurved barbs, tearing away the sting apparatus and caudal ganglion. Results in 100% fatal autotomy with prolonged apitoxin pumping.
